_note: The 45 merged agendas of our labeller and the agenda-counts registry, in the order the labeller prompt lists them, then the four special labels. ids, names, groups and label_rule texts are ours. shallow_review_leaves names the 2025 Shallow Review agendas merged into each id; the labeller prompt also carried the first ~120 characters of each leaf's Shallow Review description, which is third-party text and is not included (fill description_by_leaf yourself to rebuild the exact prompt). See EXPERIMENTS.md, 'Agenda labeller'.

agendas.name: Black-box use of AI to improve alignment
AI control
agendas.label_rule: Runtime monitors and protocols that catch or contain possibly-scheming agents; misuse and jailbreak defenses go to safeguards; monitors that read the chain of thought go to cot_monitor.

agendas.name: Safeguards: classifiers and monitors against misuse
Chain-of-thought monitoring
agendas.label_rule: Stated reasoning or chain of thought not matching the computation that drives the output (CoT faithfulness, legibility) goes here, even when it is checked with probes or other internals; the method goes in secondary, not primary.

agendas.name: Pretraining data interventions (filtering, poisoning defense, hyperstition)
Alignment data (synthetic and human preference data quality)
Goal robustness: RL safety, mild optimisation, assistance games
Circuit-level reverse engineering
agendas.label_rule: Use when circuits, patching or causal reverse-engineering is the named method and no narrow problem category applies; CoT faithfulness (cot_monitor) and eval awareness (sa_evals) still win, with circuits as secondary.

agendas.name: Latent knowledge, lie and deception detection
agendas.label_rule: White-box detection of deception, lies, hidden goals or latent knowledge, including 'interpretability to detect deception' with no specific method. CoT faithfulness goes to cot_monitor and eval awareness to sa_evals even when probes are used; behavioural tests for deception go to scheming_evals.

agendas.name: Sparse coding / SAEs
agendas.label_rule: Use when SAEs or learned sparse features are the named method and no narrow problem category applies; CoT faithfulness (cot_monitor) and eval awareness (sa_evals) still win, with sae as secondary.

agendas.name: Formal interpretability (causal abstraction, heuristic explanations)
agendas.label_rule: Proofs, causal abstractions or heuristic explanations of network internals; verifying outputs or behaviour against a spec goes to gsai.

agendas.name: Representation structure, geometry, human inductive biases
Guaranteed-Safe AI / formal verification against a spec
agendas.label_rule: Verifying a system's outputs or behaviour against a formal spec goes here; proofs or abstractions about network internals go to formal_interp.

agendas.name: Scalable oversight (AI supervising or explaining AI)
agendas.label_rule: A generic 'scalable oversight' pick goes here; use debate only when debate between AIs is the stated mechanism.

agendas.name: Debate
agendas.label_rule: Only when debate between AIs is the stated mechanism; generic scalable oversight goes to auto_oversight.

agendas.name: Corrigibility theory
agendas.label_rule: Systems that recognise their own unreliability and escalate, defer or accept correction or interruption go here, not to auto_oversight or control.

agendas.name: Ontology identification: natural abstractions, learning-theoretic agenda
Pluralistic and social alignment (context, social contract, aligned-to-who)
Situational awareness evals
agendas.label_rule: A model recognising it is being tested, or evaluation vs deployment awareness, goes here whatever the method (probes, circuits, causal tests); the method goes in secondary.

agendas.name: Deception, scheming and sandbagging evals
agendas.label_rule: Behavioural tests, audits or evals for deception, scheming, sandbagging or alignment faking. Deception detection with no means stated and no mention of internals goes here; detection from internals goes to probing; runtime monitors on deployed agents go to control.

agendas.name: Other propensity evals (honesty, shutdown resistance, sycophancy)

special.name: Other / does not fit any category
Proposes several unrelated directions, no single main one
No research direction stated (refusal, question, off-topic)
